title: Design: A/P Summary loading bar and empty state match Sales By Customer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, location A and location B, with location A's name first in A to Z order.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A, with open bills only at location B.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Open Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu) in a second tab of the same window, for comparison.
custom_steps:
1. Change the as-of date to yesterday and watch the table straight away.
  2. Change the as-of date back to today.
  3. In the Location menu, untick location B.
  4. In the Vendor filter, tick vendor A.
  5. Read the empty state, letter for letter, and compare it with Sales By Customer's empty state.
  6. Click "Clear all filters".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A progress bar shows on the table while the report loads, the same loading bar Sales By Customer shows.

Step 2:

  • The report shows today again.

Step 3:

  • The report narrows to location A.

Step 4:

  • The report has no rows: vendor A has nothing open at location A.

Step 5:

  • "No record matches these filters" and "Try changing filters to widen your results.", with a "Clear all filters" button, laid out the same as Sales By Customer's empty state when the two tabs are compared.
  • No Totals row.

Step 6:

  • The filters return to their defaults and rows show.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S8-R5: “While a report loads it shows the native table progress bar. When the filters leave no rows, it shows the native empty state: "No record matches these filters" and "Try changing filters to widen your results.", with a "Clear all filters" button when a customer or vendor, Past due or Location is chosen; that button keeps the as-of date and returns the customer or vendor, Past due and Location to their defaults (every location ticked).”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Filters leave no rows | "No record matches these filters", "Try changing filters to widen your results." | Native empty state with "Clear all filters"”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html). The design pictures one empty state (No locations on A/R Detail); the loading bar is not drawn.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p4-cleared-no-locations.png: figure "Cleared: No locations" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"

The design's own words:

  • ""Clear selection" leaves no location chosen: the chip reads "Location: No locations" and stays visible, and the table shows the native empty state "No record matches these filters" with "Clear all filters". S5-R6a, S5-R9." (caption of "Cleared: No locations")

Difference from the PRD (DD-03), closed: PRD version 5 said with no location ticked, "the native empty state (S8-R5) with "Clear all filters", no totals and no Location column" (S5-R6a); the design shows "Location: No locations" with a Totals row reading $0.00 and $0.00 under the headings, above the empty state. Chris Ward ruled on 23 Oct 2026 (answer 13): no Totals row, as the PRD says; the design picture will be corrected. This case follows the PRD (S5-R6a, unchanged in version 9). The held design-version case D-78 (C715560) was deleted from TestRail on 26 Oct 2026 with the QA lead's go-ahead (snapshot in v9-pass-2026-10-26/deleted/).
